title: Integrating Tessl with Codex
description:
Ready to supercharge your AI coding agent? Integrating Tessl allows your agent to use your project's specs from the Spec Registry, leading to more accurate and consistent code generation.

This quick tutorial walks you through connecting Tessl with Codex in just a couple of steps. 

⚙️ Run tessl setup agent from your project's root directory. 
👉 Select Codex from the list of available agents. 
✅ That's it! Tessl automatically configures the integration, and Codex is ready to go. 

Once connected, you can leverage the full power of the Tessl Spec Registry to guide your AI agent.
